capabilities_done: render-gpu feature shared-device (default off, so the default public API still names no wgpu type; test no_wgpu_types_in_public_api green): plan_sink::shared::SharedDevice::new(&wgpu::Device, &wgpu::Queue, wgpu::AdapterInfo, DeviceOptions) wraps the caller's device (clones of wgpu handles; GpuContext::from_external installs NO device-lost / uncaptured-error callback because the host owns them); render_to_texture(plan, Option<&PlanExtensions>, request, sources, cancel, &wgpu::Texture) runs the same admission/prepare/budgets/chunk passes and, per finished chunk, one compute pass encodes straight-alpha linear RGBA f32 into an Rgba8Unorm storage texture (sRGB IEC 61966-2-1, gamma-space premultiplied 8-bit = egui texture convention) at the chunk position: no staging copy, no map, no TileSink (GpuStats.bytes_read_back = 0); target refusals (format != Rgba8Unorm, not 2D, multisampled, no STORAGE_BINDING, smaller than the plan extent) = Backend(Sink(Rejected)) before any device work; backend() exposes the same device through the read-back TileSink path; re-exports SharedDevice, TARGET_FORMAT, SHARED_DESCRIPTOR
